scope: single CUDA0, fixed output-first ngl, plain CPU/CUDA buffers, no repack/host/mmap/lazy, full attention, FP16 KV, one sequence

measurement_boundary.validated: independent GGUF tensor directory/raw placement, per-layer model/KV device assignments, and model/KV requested buffer bytes versus printed rounding intervals
measurement_boundary.not_validated: driver physical allocation granularity, process VRAM peak, inference quality, throughput, capacity-policy calibration, general GPU/model compatibility
measurement_boundary.device_sampling: nvidia-smi GPU-index-0 total device memory before/during/after includes other processes, driver and CUDA context; sampled maximum is not a process peak
measurement_boundary.unsupported_telemetry: WSL/WDDM unavailable fields are null with a reason; absent measurements are never numeric zero or marked passed
measurement_boundary.planning_RAM: Linux sysconf visible RAM is used as capacity; on WSL this is the VM limit, not Windows physical RAM or currently free memory

allocation_oracle.CPU_model: sum(align_up(raw_tensor_bytes,32)) over unique actual CPU tensor objects
allocation_oracle.CUDA_model: sum(align_up(raw_tensor_bytes + quant_tail,128)); quant_tail=(((-ne0)%512)/block_elements)*block_bytes for quantized tensors, otherwise 0; added once per tensor
allocation_oracle.FP16_KV: S=align_up(requested_context,256); one K or V tensor=2*kv_heads*head_dim*S; sum both tensors per layer aligned to its CPU32/CUDA128 buffer; output slot has no KV
allocation_oracle.tied_weights: CPU alias shares original allocation when ngl=0; when output offloads, original CPU embedding remains and one independently padded CUDA duplicate is allocated
allocation_oracle.rounding: reported decimal buffer sizes define a half-last-digit interval, plus one byte numerical slack; no broad percentage tolerance
allocation_oracle.upstream_INFO_caveat: pinned max-offload repeating-layer INFO count underreports by one; acceptance uses DEBUG per-layer assignments, not that summary
